QuestInfo.name: Spring Picnic Fashion
QuestInfo.0: You heard that monsters stole all of Cassandra's spring clothes for her picnic. Should you go and help her out?
QuestInfo.1: Hunt those monsters and take back Cassandra's clothes.
QuestInfo.2: Now that Cassandra has her clothes back, she should be able to fully enjoy the spring picnic.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: More Spring Picnic Fashion now available.\n\n
